quest.title: Pressing Deadlines
quest.description: Clerk Zhao is so swamped with work that she can't even get a moment to herself. It seems she could use some assistance...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x6, Golden Crab x3

talks.objective: Give the invoice to Nervous An

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: *sigh* I thought about it, but there's just not enough time... I have to work harder.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I'll burn the midnight oil tonight, and tomorrow, and the day after that... see if I can finish recording all the ships in the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: After all, this was the very first report I started working on, so it shouldn't be the last one I submit.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Oh boy, now I'm in trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Clerk Zhao told me to give this to you...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Huh? She needs a report of all the ships in the harbor!?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: This... I actually had started keeping track of this at the very start...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: But then there's also the imported goods report, the reports on crew information, and the customs report...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: There's just sooo much to keep track of — report this, record that, I simply can't keep up with it all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hire some help...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I want to, but it will take some time to find someone, so that won't help me finish the work at hand...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just do this report that Clerk Zhao wants first.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Hahaha! I don't even have enough time to remember all the information I need to report, let alone fill it out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do the most important reports first.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think the reports are all of about equal importance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's no time...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I know, so I'm trying my best now... I'll see if I can finish all the reports.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just go and explain the situation...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: But I still have some time, I should just work harder to finish these reports...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help out.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Thanks for the offer, but if you aren't familiar with the work you won't be much help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still going to put it off to later?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I'll try to finish it on time, but as you can see I already have so much work to do, haha... It will be difficult to not put it off.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then you need to figure it out yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I know, I know... This is my job, I can't rely on other people to do it for.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Prioritize your work better next time.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I always tell myself I should, but I just get so busy that I forget to prioritize.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: There's no way we can settle this many forms...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Okay then... With a bit more time, I'll touch up the plan and fix some minor issues.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: I'll submit it when I'm done touching it up.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: I hope everyone really enjoys this year's Lantern Rite...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: No, that's not quite right either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Clerk Zhao told me to give this to you...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Hmm? About the plans for Lantern Rite...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm writing that right now. But it feels like it's missing something, so I keep editing it.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Everybody needs to do their very best for a big festival like Lantern Rite. So... I can't submit this plan just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're running out of time...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: I know I can come up with the best plan, I just need a bit more time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just submit it now.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: What!? I can't carelessly submit what amounts to a rough draft, this is Liyue's most important festival!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It will never be perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: That may be true, but I should strive for perfection, no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any plan is better than no plan.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: That's true, but I shouldn't submit a plan that has something wrong with it, should I?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's nothing wrong with your plan.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Hmm, it may not have any glaring problems, but at least let me improve it even more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Submit it first, you can change more later.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Are you joking? Lantern Rite is a serious festival, there are procedures.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Get ideas from last year's plan...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: I've already been looking at last year's Lantern Rite. But... even though it was very popular among residents, I still think I can come up with something really special.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Be confident...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: What good is confidence if the people of Liyue don't like it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then... keep thinking?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Yes! Give me a bit more time and I'll be able to write the perfect plan.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: You're back. Thank you so much, Nervous An and Jiangzhou already sent me a message.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: They said they will definitely submit their work on time.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Excellent... At the very least I can sleep well tonight...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Take these as thanks. You have really been a great help.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: After this ordeal, I'm sure they won't repeat this kind of mistake again...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I mean, you've seen how busy I am.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: All of these different tasks to do at once, and all equally important.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Darn, looks like I'll simply have to put off this report to another time.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: No... The people of Liyue have been eagerly looking forward to Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Nobody will be satisfied if it's just a touched-up version of last year's plan.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Don't try to stop me... I still need to make some changes, need to make the perfect plan...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: What? They still can't finish on time?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Another extension? Do they want to do this job or not?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Well, never mind. I suppose I'll have to find the time to chase them myself...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Take these, and thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: You're back. Nervous An and Jiangzhou just sent me a message.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Only one of them promised they would submit their work on time, but I guess one is better than none.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: As for the other one, I'll just have to continue to press them...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Regardless, I'm grateful for your help. Take these as thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Ugh... It's never a slow day at work, that's for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: There's still so much work, what should I do...?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: I have to come up with the very best plan...
